issues.description: The problem statement UML declares numberOfInscribedStudents and numberOfGuestStudents as type double, while the solution implementation declares them as int. This mismatch can confuse students when choosing types for these attributes and how to implement getTotalNumberOfStudents (which the UML specifies returns int).
issues.suggestedFix: Make the types consistent across artifacts. Either (A) update the problem statement UML to declare numberOfInscribedStudents and numberOfGuestStudents as int (preferred, since getTotalNumberOfStudents is specified to return int), or (B) change the solution and template to use double for those attributes and adjust getTotalNumberOfStudents (and related methods) accordingly so return types and calculations remain consistent. Also ensure the constructor and getters/setters signatures match the chosen types.
